meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容编排成可翻页的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把想法整理成演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create a navigable slideshow from your content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to turn ideas into a slide deck

howto.what: 装上后,你要做幻灯片时,Claude 会生成一个可翻页演示的 HyperFrames 幻灯片(不是视频),含分页、片段显现、分支跳转、热点与演讲者备注;也能把现有网页改造成这种可演示 deck,并会先静默更新技能。
howto.when: 当你明确要求「幻灯片」「演示文稿」或「HyperFrames slideshow」时直接触发;若你说「做个展示」「把某网页转成 deck」等相近请求,它会先解释并征求确认后再执行。

say.text: 把这份季度汇报做成幻灯片
把我们的定价页转成演示 deck,保留动效
say.note: 它会先确认转换再执行

say.text: 给第 3 页加一个点击图表才进入的分支页

howto.what_en: Claude creates a navigable HyperFrames deck (not video) with slides, fragments, branching, hotspots, presenter notes; can convert an existing page to a deck; silently updates the skill first.
howto.when_en: Immediately triggered by explicit requests for 'slideshow', 'slide show', or 'HyperFrames slideshow'. For adjacent asks like 'presentation', 'pitch deck', or 'convert this page', it explains and asks for confirmation first.

say_en.text: Turn this quarterly report into a slideshow.
Convert our pricing page into a deck, keeping the motion.
Add a branch slide reachable by clicking the chart on slide 3.
say_en.note: Hotspot jump to a branch sequence.
